name: Rocket Stick Minis - Injected Pre Roll Pack (5 x 0.6g) - Lemon Meringue Pie
description:
Big flavor, mini size. The Rocket Stick Minis Lemon Meringue Pie pack gives you five 0.6-gram infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and injected with distillate and terpenes for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing with friends, or keeping a few on hand.

Lemon Meringue Pie serves up a bakery-fresh flavor: bright, zesty lemon up front layered over sweet whipped meringue and a buttery pie-crust finish. It's a tangy-meets-creamy dessert profile built for easy, flavorful sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

5 × 0.6G infused minis — 3G total, quality flower injected with distillate and terpenes
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Signature Lemon Meringue Pie flavor — zesty lemon with sweet meringue and buttery crust
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every mini. Rocket Stick Minis Lemon Meringue Pie is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
